name: FracAtlas (Abedeen 2023, Scientific Data)
what: 4,083 musculoskeletal radiographs from three Bangladeshi hospitals (hand, leg, hip, shoulder), 717 with 922 fracture instances, boxes and masks; the hip and pelvis films show the sacrum and L5
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; a South Asian population and devices the project has not seen
how_to_get: Open https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/The_dataset/22363012 (to confirm) or the Hugging Face mirror yh0701/FracAtlas_dataset and read the file list.

Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE from figshare, or python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py hf-get --repo yh0701/FracAtlas_dataset --repo-type dataset --dest DIR.
